project_info.name: DutchBay Hybrid Wind+Solar
project_info.location: Dutch Bay, Kalpitiya, Puttalam District, Sri Lanka

created_by: M3 hybrid (canonical wind bankable export + pvlib-modelled solar P50/P90, #469)
notes: Combined bankable AEP for the 209.6 MW hybrid = wind 464.3 GWh (15 x IEA-10MW-198 via wind_resource.bankable_aep, incl. a 2.0% pre-construction P50 over-prediction haircut from the modelled 473.8; ERA5-fitted Weibull A=8.199/k=2.665; PyWake 7.28% wake; 14.48% total losses) + solar 78.4 GWh (50 MW fixed-tilt, Puttalam GHI, pvlib-MODELLED P50 CF 0.179 from solar_resource.pv_producer; re-baselined #469 from the prior declared 0.20, -10.5%). Net CF 0.295502 over 209.6 MW nameplate reconciles with capacity_mw*capacity_factor (the engine bills revenue off that). The per-tech split drives the lender reporting (generation.technologies). Combined net P90-1yr 475.1 = wind 404.4 + solar 70.7, the solar component now MODELLED via solar_resource.exceedance (default IEA-PVPS Task 13 budget, sigma ~7.65%; #469 dolphin 4c replaced the prior ratio-preserved placeholder). P90 BINDS the gearing here (Financing_Terms.bind_downside true, D4.6): the P90/P50 ratio 475.1/542.7 = 0.8754 rescales CFADS to size the debt, so this P90 drives the financed equity-IRR / LLCR / DSCR / balloon (no longer reporting-only).
